title: When the Rivergate Falls
author: Lena Sandoval
blurb: Sable Sterling, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
